8+ hours of play, spread over several days (each boss only every 44 h; Ferumbras every 14 days)

The scholar {npc:Mazarius}, in Darashia, wants to stop {creature:Ferumbras} from gaining divine powers. You open the gates of hell with 30 {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences}, cross the {wiki:Hell Hub} and, at each of the seven seals of the {wiki:The Ruthless Seven Minions|Ruthless Seven Minions}, solve a puzzle, kill the boss and send a piece of {wiki:The Godbreaker} with the {item:Teleportation Rod}. At the end you discover that Mazarius has betrayed you and face {creature:Ascending Ferumbras} with up to 15 players in the {wiki:Halls of Ascension}. Reward: the {wiki:Rift Warrior Outfits|Rift Warrior} outfit, the achievement **Hat Hunter**, decorative items and the chance to loot {item:Ferumbras' Hat}.
Ferumbras is about to gain divine powers and must be stopped.
**Level 150** to be able to talk to {npc:Mazarius} (since the patch of 31 July 2018). Recommended level: **250+** (teams of level 300–400 are already considered low).
Team: up to **5 players** per seal boss, up to **3 players at a time** in the access to Mazoran's seal and up to **15 players** in the final fight against Ferumbras.
30 {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences} for Mazarius to open the gates of hell.
for Mazarius; they drop from Demons, Destroyers, Furies, Dark Torturers, Blightwalkers and other demons
listed as required equipment in the spoiler (cancels the effects of drunkenness)
the spoiler asks for «Pick, Shovel or equivalent»; the shovel (or a secret agent tool) is used on the gravestone in Ragiaz's seal
listed with the Shovel in the spoiler's required equipment (or an equivalent tool)
Mazarius gives it to you; if you lose it, he sells you another for 1,000 gp
the only recommended weapon for the shooters against Plagirath
mages, on the way to Ragiaz
optional, to trap Ragiaz's Death Dragons
or Energy Bombs, to keep creatures away on the way to Shulgrax
per player, required in Ferumbras's 3rd phase
or {item:Helmet of the Deep} (diving equipment) against drown damage in the final fight
Fire protection for paladins and mages; {wiki:Mana Drain} protection for mages in the fight against {creature:Ferumbras Mortal Shell}
to go to the Adventurers' Guild and collect the boss loot you left in the room
Lots of potions and runes: the areas are full of Vexclaws, Hellflayers and Grimeleeches
{wiki:Rift Warrior Outfits|Rift Warrior} outfit (base), given by {npc:Heavenly Messenger}
Each of the seven seal bosses gives **500,000 XP** and always drops 1 {item:Silver Token}; {creature:Ferumbras Mortal Shell} gives **2,000,000 XP** and 1 to 5 Silver Tokens
Chance to loot {item:Ferumbras' Hat} (very rare) and the {item:Mysterious Scroll} from {creature:Ferumbras Mortal Shell}
Hell Hub and the seven Grounds of the Ruthless Seven Minions
When you hand the 30 {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences} to {npc:Mazarius}: the portal north of him, in Darashia, takes you to the Hell Hub.
Shortcut to Plagirath's floor (Grounds of Plague)
After killing {creature:The Lord of the Lice} for the first time, you can use the teleport at {coord:33201,31425,11}.
After killing {creature:The Shatterer} for the first time, you can use the teleport at {coord:33395,32460,13}.
Halls of Ascension and the fight against Ferumbras
After sending the seven pieces of {wiki:The Godbreaker}: a new portal opens in Mazarius's room.
You can face Ferumbras every 13 days and 20 hours, with up to 15 players.
Rift Warrior Outfits (and purchase of the addons)
By saying {key:hi} to the {npc:Heavenly Messenger} after killing Ferumbras.
Both addons are bought from {npc:Cledwyn} for 100 {item:Silver Token|Silver Tokens} each.
Completing the quest gives you the base outfit, which is the requirement for that quest.
Rift Runner mount (use the Mysterious Scroll)
Only those who have completed the quest can use the {item:Mysterious Scroll}, loot from the {creature:Ferumbras Mortal Shell}.
Without the quest done you get *The ascension of great evil must be stopped before the secret of this scroll may be revealed.*

For lower-level teams (300–400), a good strategy is to gather **10 players** for the puzzles and minibosses (faster, safer and cheaper) and split into **2 groups of 5** only when it is time for the bosses.

Each seal's mission is only done when you use the {item:Teleportation Rod} on the Godbreaker piece, **not** when you kill the boss. Leave the boss room right afterwards and leave the loot to collect later at the {wiki:Adventurers' Guild}: if you stay in the room and time runs out, you are kicked out and have to kill the boss again.
After killing a boss, the exit teleport takes you back to the safe room before the entrance: you don't need to save supplies for the way back, as long as you reach the boss.
Each seal boss has a cooldown of **44 hours** and a fight of at most **17 minutes**. Ferumbras has a cooldown of **13 days and 20 hours** and a fight of at most **45 minutes**.
Bring fire protection (paladins and mages), diving equipment and Mana Drain protection for the final fight.
1. Opening the gates of hell: Mazarius in Darashia
It all starts with the scholar Mazarius, an expert on ascension, who asks for your help to stop Ferumbras from becoming a god.

Travel to **Darashia**: by boat (say {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes} to the captain; you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s harbour) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}'s platform). Petros links Darashia to Ankrahmun (100 gp), Gray Island (150), Issavi (130), Krailos (110), Liberty Bay (200), Port Hope (180), Venore (60) and Yalahar (210 gp): he is how you get back at the end (or via Chemar's carpet).
{npc:Mazarius} lives in the **north-east** part of Darashia. Enter the house and go down 1 floor (floor -1): that is where he is.

Mazarius does not talk to characters below **level 150**. Without that it is impossible to open the gates of hell and continue the quest (those who already had access before 31/07/2018 were not affected).
Say {key:hi}, {key:short} and {key:yes}. When he asks for your help to stop {creature:Ferumbras} from gaining divine powers, accept.
With the 30 {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences} in your inventory, say {key:demonic essence} and {key:yes}. The gates of hell are now open for you.

Mazarius gives you a {item:Teleportation Rod}. Your task is to use it on the **seven pieces** of {wiki:The Godbreaker}, hidden in the dungeons of the {wiki:The Ruthless Seven Minions|Ruthless Seven Minions}, to send them safely to him.
If you lose the rod, Mazarius sells you another for 1,000 gp (while he is still in the room, before the final part).

The {wiki:Hell Hub}, under the sea east of Darashia, links the seven Grounds of the Ruthless Seven Minions. Each seal has demons, a puzzle, a boss (up to 5 players) and a room with a piece of the Godbreaker.
In {npc:Mazarius}'s room, enter the portal **north** of him. You first appear in a {wiki:Protection Zone|protection zone} (safe room): get ready here.
Path from the protection zone to the portal room
Follow the caves, fighting {creature:Vexclaw|Vexclaws}, {creature:Hellflayer|Hellflayers}, {creature:Grimeleech|Grimeleeches} and {creature:Demon|Demons}. At the end of the cave, go down the stairs.
The wiki recommends level 300+ for mages and paladins and 350+ for knights in this area.
You reach a large room with paths to the portals of each of the seven minions. On the map you start at the white circle; the numbers are the seals in the table. You can do them in any order.
The seven Hell Hub portals (you start at the white circle)

In each seal: you cross the area full of demons, solve the puzzle (or kill a miniboss), enter the lever room (5 tiles), kill the boss with up to 5 players and, in the next room, use the {item:Teleportation Rod} on the Godbreaker piece.
Room with one of the seven Godbreaker pieces

The mission only counts when you use the rod on the piece. Leave the boss room right after killing it: if the room's time runs out (17 minutes) you are teleported out and have to kill the boss again. The loot can be collected later at the {wiki:Adventurers' Guild}.

Each boss can be attempted **every 44 hours**. To collect the loot left in the room: in the temple of any city use an {item:Adventurer's Stone} (ask the temple NPC for one: {key:hi}, {key:adventurer's stone}, {key:yes}) to go to the {wiki:Adventurers' Guild}; the loot appears in the {wiki:Reward Chest}. To leave, use the guild's exit portal, which takes you back to the temple you came from.

After using the rod, the exit teleport takes you back to the safe room before the entrance. From there go back the same way to Mazarius's room, in Darashia. If you want to leave halfway through a seal, retrace your steps to the portal room and go up through the caves to the protection zone.

The wiki does not describe the return from the Hell Hub to Darashia in detail. Alternatively, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your home town's temple (it does not work in No-Logout zones or with Logout Block / Protection Zone Block).
This seal is just a miniboss and the boss. Creatures: Vexclaws, Hellflayers, Grimeleeches, Plaguesmiths, Defilers and Disgusting Oozes.
Getting to the Grounds of Plague
In the Hell Hub portal room, follow the path to the **north-west** teleport and enter it.
Go to the miniboss lever room
You start in the **north-east** corner. Follow the path in the image to the teleport in the **south-west** and enter a small room with 5 tiles and a lever.
Path to The Lord of the Lice
Put the team on the tiles and pull the lever. Everyone is taken to the **north** of a large room; {creature:The Lord of the Lice} is to the **south**.
Attack him and get rid of the creatures he summons. It is a simple fight. After killing him, leave the room through the **south** teleport.
After killing him for the first time, you can use the teleport at {coord:33201,31425,11} if the team wants to return to Plagirath or hunt on the second floor.
You appear on another floor. Head **north-west** and go through the teleport to enter the lever room.
Shortcut teleport (after the first Lord of the Lice)

Put the team (up to 5) on the tiles and pull the lever. The knight stays in the **centre** of the room (as far away as possible, but so that the druid can still see him at the edge of the screen) and the shooters stay in the **south-east** or **south-west** corners. The {creature:Disgusting Ooze|Disgusting Oozes} spawn constantly and paralyse hard: let the knight block them and attack **only with {item:Great Fireball Rune|Great Fireball Runes}** (paladins with diamond arrows). If an Ooze goes after a shooter, the paladin leads it to the knight and returns to the corner.

{creature:Plagirath} sometimes turns his target into a Bog Raider. When the effect ends (about 10 s), everyone around (an area the size of a UE) takes **1,500 damage**. The Oozes **do not disappear** when the boss dies: leave in an organised way.

Weak to fire (takes 125% damage) and energy (110%), immune to earth. Killing him near the exit teleport makes leaving safer (in the wiki image he is killed just west of that teleport, with two blockers).
Plagirath being killed west of the exit teleport
Leave the boss room and use the {item:Teleportation Rod} on the Godbreaker piece. The exit teleport takes you back to the safe room before the entrance.
1st Godbreaker piece sent; 500,000 XP and Plagirath's loot (always includes 1 Silver Token)
Three puzzles in a row (lever, lonely monsters and a maze of fake walls) before the boss. Creatures: Vexclaws, Hellflayers, Grimeleeches, Phantasms and Nightmares.
Getting to the Grounds of Deceit
In the Hell Hub portal room, follow the path to the **north** teleport and enter it.

You arrive in the **south** part of the map. Follow the blue line **north** to the blue flag: there is a lever here that **each team member** has to pull. The message *In another room south of this one, something just made a loud booming sound.* appears. The lever takes a few seconds to reset for the next player.
Blue line to the lever (flag) and teleport (exclamation mark)
When everyone has pulled the lever, go **south** to the red exclamation mark just below the lever and enter the teleport.

There are **8 rooms**, each with a lever at the door. Pulling the lever makes a monster appear in the room and, for a short time, that room's floor changes to the landscape of the monster in the opposite room. You have to take each lonely monster to the room **opposite** it **while that room's floor matches the monster's landscape**. Examples: the {creature:Lonely Frazzlemaw} goes in when the floor looks like {wiki:Roshamuul}'s; the {creature:Lonely Deer} when it looks like a lawn with pine trees.
The 8 rooms of the monster puzzle
Correct landscape of the opposite room

The monsters are very weak: **don't kill them**. A knight uses {spell:Challenge} (exeta res) and leads them along the corridor. Only one player needs to pull the lever; it counts for everyone who is **inside** the room when the creature enters.

When the creature enters the right room, it disappears and you hear *That seemed correct!*. If you fail, you hear *That seemed wrong!*: no problem, pull the lever again to make another monster appear. Repeat in all 8 rooms and then enter the teleport to the **south**.

You arrive in the **north-westernmost** room of this map. The rooms only have walls, no doors: in some places you can walk through the walls. Follow the blue line to the teleport in the **south-east** and enter it: you reach the last room before the boss.
Maze map (you start in the north-west)
Blue line through the walls you can walk through
The monsters in the other rooms only attack you if you are in the same room as them or inside the wall.

Put the team on the 5 tiles and pull the lever. {creature:Zamulosh} always summons 1 equally strong copy and 5 weaker ones, and often turns invisible. The team stays in a **corner** of the room with the knight in front, holding the copies and the boss, and everyone uses their best area damage ({item:Avalanche Rune|Avalanche Runes}, diamond arrows).
If not all versions are being attacked, the team is teleported to the **centre** of the room. If that happens, go back to the corner and make sure everyone attacks all the copies, not just one.
Takes only 50% of fire damage. The copies disappear when the real one dies.
Leave through the **green** teleport and use the {item:Teleportation Rod} on the Godbreaker piece. The exit teleport takes you to the safe room before the entrance.
Godbreaker piece sent; 500,000 XP and Zamulosh's loot (always includes 1 Silver Token)

It is by far the hardest seal to get through: you kill Vexclaws, Hellflayers, Hellfire Fighters, Hellhounds and Furies non-stop, and the access can only be done by **3 players at a time**. If no one on the team has done it before, go prepared to repeat it several times.
Getting to the Grounds of Fire
On the Hell Hub teleport floor, go to the **north-easternmost** teleport and enter it.
You appear here. Stay **close to the walls**: if you go to the centre you can be surrounded by more than 8 creatures. Follow the path to the stairs in the **south-east** and go down.
Arrival at the Grounds of Fire

On this floor there are 3 levers flooded with lava (arrows on the map), 3 fountains with a coloured tile next to them (red crosses) and another 3 levers side by side that you use at the end (blue flag, near the stairs).
Mazoran's puzzle: flooded levers (arrows), fountains (crosses) and final levers (flag)

Each of the 3 players steps on one of the 3 coloured tiles. The fountain fills with lava, the lava around one of the flooded levers drains for a while and you receive a message with a **colour sequence**, for example *You hear a whisper: 'You will not be guided but your path shines in the colours green, blue and red. Heed this hierarchy.'* **Write down your sequence.** All 3 tiles have to be stepped on for the 3 levers to become accessible.
If you fail and come back later, your sequence is still valid.
Pull the levers in your order

The flooded levers are marked on the map with red, green and blue circles. Pull them **in the order given in your message**. After the last one you receive an element: **blood**, **ice** or **grass** (e.g. *A booming sound almost deafens you. From somewhere deep within you hear a whisper: 'Ice...'*).

After the lava drains, it takes about **5 minutes** to come back. If you are inside the pool when it fills, you are teleported to the centre of the floor, probably with the creatures already back. If you pull in the wrong order, you have to step on a coloured tile again to receive a new sequence (it may or may not be the same).

When everyone has their element, go to the blue flag near the stairs. Each of the 3 levers has an ice, blood or grass tile next to it: stand on the tile **south** of your element's lever and pull it. You enter the boss lever room.

Pull the lever with the team on the tiles. This boss is one of the easiest: the blocker takes him to the **south** part of the room and the shooters stay against the wall. Every few minutes the floor turns to **lava** and 5 {creature:Rage of Mazoran|Rages of Mazoran} spawn: don't walk while there is lava and kill the Rages with area damage (ice works well). If needed, pass them to the blocker when the lava disappears (you then have about a minute to walk safely).
Walking on the lava deals **1,500 fire damage**. {creature:Mazoran} is immune to fire.
Leave the room and use the {item:Teleportation Rod} on the Godbreaker piece. The exit teleport takes you to the safe room before the entrance.
Godbreaker piece sent; 500,000 XP and Mazoran's loot (always includes 1 Silver Token)

Similar to Plagirath's seal: you have to kill a miniboss (at least once) to reach the boss room, but it is harder. Creatures: Juggernauts, Destroyers, Furies, Demons, Vexclaws, Hellflayers and Grimeleeches. The wiki recommends level **400+** for knights and **350+** for paladins and mages here.
Getting to the Grounds of Destruction

In the Hell Hub portal room, go to the **east** teleport and enter it. Inside, be very careful: as you approach the centre of the large rooms you can be surrounded by many {creature:Juggernaut|Juggernauts}, Vexclaws, Grimeleeches and Hellflayers.
Follow the path in the image to the blue flag: you enter a small room with 5 tiles and a lever. Put the team on the tiles and pull it.

In the middle of the next room is {creature:The Fettered Shatterer}, held by 4 chains. To free him, pull 4 levers: the **north** one (guarded by 4 {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers}), the **west** one (guarded by 4 {creature:Fury|Furies}), and the **south** and **east** ones, whose paths are blocked by rocks and hidden by fire fields (white lines in the image). When you pull the hidden levers, the fire disappears and you can see the path.
The 4 levers and the hidden paths (white lines)
If the chains don't disappear after the 4 levers, walk around the corresponding lever again.
Kill {creature:The Shatterer}. The shooters stand **diagonally** and at some distance to dodge the waves and the explosion. He is immune to fire and earth.
As soon as he dies, the team is teleported to the next room, with the same creatures as before: go ready.
Follow the path to the blue flag to enter the boss lever room. Walk along the edges and don't pull too many monsters from the centre of the rooms.
After killing the Shatterer for the first time, you can use the shortcut teleport if you want to fight Razzagorn again.

Pull the lever. In the room are {creature:Razzagorn} and 4 scattered {creature:Demon|Demons}. The team stays on the **west** side of the room, so that the Demons in the east don't rejoin the fight when they respawn. The room casts {wiki:Paralyze} from time to time. The boss summons {creature:Eruption of Destruction|Eruptions of Destruction} throughout the fight: as soon as one appears, **everyone attacks it** until it dies, even if a Demon or the boss is almost dead.

If an Eruption doesn't die within **8 seconds**, it explodes (up to 2,500 energy, fire, physical and mana drain damage), heals the boss by 11,500 to 19,500 and spawns another Demon. Only attack Razzagorn when there are no Eruptions alive.
Takes only 60% of fire damage and 90% of holy damage.
Leave the room and use the {item:Teleportation Rod} on the piece of {wiki:The Godbreaker}. The exit teleport takes you to the safe room before the entrance.
Godbreaker piece sent; 500,000 XP and Razzagorn's loot (always includes 1 Silver Token)

Along the way you pick up the items for a ritual that each player has to perform. Creatures: Undead Dragons, Blightwalkers, Death Dragons, Vexclaws, Hellflayers and Grimeleeches. Mages: bring {item:Thunderstorm Rune|Thunderstorm Runes}, they are more effective on the way to the boss.
Getting to the Grounds of Undeath
In the Hell Hub portal room, go to the **south-east** teleport and enter it. Then follow the path **south**, picking up the ritual items in the order below.
Path to Ragiaz, with the locations of the ritual items

In the small room after the teleport, pick a {item:Grave Flower} from the one planted in the ground. **Each player** needs their own; the flower grows back after about 30 seconds. There are several flowers in the area (see map).
Go down the hole and go down again to the **north**: you find {item:The Rite of Eternal Night}.
Continue along the path until you find a small white gravestone. Use the {item:Shovel} (or a secret agent tool) **in front of** it and you receive {item:House Silversun's Signet Ring}.
To the **south-east** of the gravestone there are two coffins. Use the one with a **blue flower** on top and you receive {item:Bones (Item)|Bones}.
Head **south** to some ashes. Use the ashes and you receive {item:Vampire Teeth}.
Go down to the safe area
With all the items, go down the hole: it is a safe area. Here **each player** has to perform the ritual once, so some patience is needed.

Use each of the items ({item:Grave Flower}, {item:House Silversun's Signet Ring}, {item:Bones (Item)|Bones} and {item:Vampire Teeth}) on the **south-east** corner of the {wiki:Dried Well}. The Rite (the sheet) is left for the end.
Placing the first of the 4 items
Put out the torch on the statue just **north-west** of the Dried Well.
Ritual 3: read the Rite by the well
Go back to the Dried Well and use {item:The Rite of Eternal Night}. **Blood** must start flowing from the well: you now have access to the next area.
Using the Rite by the well
Enter the gate to the **north** and follow the path to the lever room.
Path from the gate to the lever room

Pull the lever. With {creature:Ragiaz} are 4 {creature:Death Dragon|Death Dragons}, which respawn immediately when they die (it is not worth killing them). From time to time Ragiaz turns into a {creature:Bone Capsule}, a motionless cocoon: **kill it as fast as possible**, because the longer it lives the more health Ragiaz recovers. Then Ragiaz reappears in the centre of the room. Choose one of the methods in the table.
The blocker holds the 4 Death Dragons and Ragiaz at the same time. Dangerous depending on level; a 350+ knight with two druids should be enough.
At the first Bone Capsule, the blocker and 2–3 mages go **north** to trap the Death Dragons with {item:Wild Growth Rune|Wild Growths}, while the other shooters attack the cocoon.
One blocker takes the 4 Death Dragons away from Ragiaz. Only if the shooters have a lot of damage (all 350+?), because only 4 players attack the boss.
Whatever the method, be quick: if the fight takes too long, the team is kicked out of the room when time runs out.
Takes only 50% (or less) of death damage and 80% of earth damage.
Leave the room and use the {item:Teleportation Rod} on the Godbreaker piece. The exit teleport takes you to the safe room before the entrance.
Godbreaker piece sent; 500,000 XP and Ragiaz's loot (always includes 1 Silver Token)

An easy puzzle with no creatures: help the nameless NPC ({npc:...}) find out his name by finding clues to 5 letters in the ruins. Track your progress in the {wiki:Quest Log}. Some fields are invisible on the map and very slow: be patient and look for the right passages.
Getting to the Grounds of Despair
In the Hell Hub portal room, follow the path **south-west** of the stairs and enter the teleport. Then follow the map to the puzzle area.
These maps show all the places you have to go to find the five letters.

Go to the **north-west** room and enter it through the room to the south. Inside there is a lever that **all players** have to pull: each one receives a colour and an element (*Blood*, *Decay*, *Magic* or *Clay*).
Go up the stairs next to the lever and walk **south**. You cross a labyrinth of invisible walls (with many diagonal steps). At the end, pull the lever for your element.
By adjusting the graphics settings you may be able to make out the tiles you can walk on (they have a slightly different colour). If you don't know your colour, try the four levers until one works.

Go back to the main area and go to the **north-east** room, which has some animals. They don't damage you but they have much more health than normal creatures. **Don't kill them**, you need them alive. Between the first and the second totem, use the wall to get a {item:Bone Flute}.

Use the {item:Bone Flute} on the animal that matches your spirit, several times. On the wrong animal a red message appears saying it is not your spirit animal; on the right one, the sound is different. It may take several attempts: you know you've succeeded when the flute disappears and the Quest Log is updated.
Use it on the right animal until the Quest Log updates

Get a {item:Fire Bug} from the chest in the **north-west** corner of the room just north of the NPC {npc:...}. Then go to the room on the **east** side of the ruins and light one of the basins to update the Quest Log.

Before you continue, make sure **all** the Fire Basins in the north room are lit. Go to the room to the **south**, with {item:Bookcase|Bookcases}. Move the {item:Pendulum Clock} next to the bookcase near the door and use the plaque it was hiding. If the Quest Log doesn't update, take one step **south** and try again (you see a light effect on yourself and receive the update).
5th letter: the labyrinth of fake doors
Continue **south** and go up the ladder. Find the way **north** through this labyrinth with several fake doors and use the plaque on the wall to get the last letter.
After the 5 letters, the entries disappear from the Quest Log. That is normal, carry on.
Take the Desperate Soul to its owner

Lure the {creature:Desperate Soul} (a white rabbit you have probably already seen around) to the room of the NPC {npc:...}, to the **south-west**. The soul disappears when it finds its owner. Don't try to kill it: it runs away very fast and takes no damage.
Talk to {npc:...}: say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and his name, {key:tevon}.
Go to the room to the north and go down the ladder to continue towards the boss. Follow the map around the ruins to the lever room.
Path around the ruins to the lever room

Pull the lever. In the room there are 4 {creature:Guilt|Guilts} that don't move but attack from range: avoid the centre and stay near one of the corners. {creature:Tarbaz} isn't very strong, attack him. At some point the team is teleported to another room where everyone walks **very slowly**: follow the path staying out of the Guilts' melee range, kill the 4 {creature:Despair|Despairs} blocking the way and, at the end, enter the teleport to return to Tarbaz's room.
The main cause of failure here is **running out of time**. Don't waste time: the shooters attack the Despairs as soon as they are in range.
After killing the boss, enter the teleport and use the {item:Teleportation Rod} on the Godbreaker piece. The exit teleport takes you to the safe room before the entrance.
Godbreaker piece sent; 500,000 XP and Tarbaz's loot (always includes 1 Silver Token)
One of the easiest seals: the puzzle and the boss are relatively safe. Creatures: Dark Torturers, Sin Devourers, Vexclaws, Hellflayers and Grimeleeches.
Getting to the Grounds of Damnation

In the Hell Hub portal room, enter the Grounds of Damnation teleport (the **west** one, according to the area's page). Follow the path **south-east** and go down the stairs. There are many creatures along the way: use {item:Energy Wall Rune|Energy Walls} or {item:Energy Bomb Rune|Energy Bombs} to keep them away from the corridors you won't be going through.
Teleport to the Grounds of Damnation
The next floor is large and has the puzzle. Go **west** and then **north**. Go through the door to the **east**, then go **north** and **west** to the Puzzle Garden.
When you reach the solution area, with metal tiles, **don't step on them**. If you step on them at random, you may have to wait for them to reset (10 minutes).

In the Puzzle Garden there are three gardens with **blue**, **red** and **yellow** roses. Take a screenshot or write down the position of all the flowers: they are the solution to the puzzle. You can also split the team and call out the positions to each other.

On the tiles to the **south**, match the colours of each square to the flowers of the corresponding garden. To see the colours clearly, enable *Show Light Effects*, lower the *Ambient Light* (Options > Graphics > Effects) and take off any equipment that gives off light. You can also see the colours on the minimap (there, **green** corresponds to the **blue** flowers/tiles).
The colours on the minimap (green = blue)
It is not possible to turn a tile back to blank. If you step on a tile that should have stayed neutral, you have to wait for the puzzle to reset and check the flowers again.
Pull the lever and go through the gate
With the right tiles, you have **10 minutes** to pull the lever (**each player** pulls it once) and enter the gate to the boss lever room. After the 10 minutes, the flowers change to a new pattern.

Pull the lever with the team on the tiles. At the start and every few minutes, {creature:Shulgrax} summons about 5 {creature:Sin Devourer|Sin Devourers} and 3–4 {creature:Damned Soul|Damned Souls}. The Sin Devourers paralyse and greatly lower your skills and magic level. The Damned Souls run away; when you kill them they turn into a {item:Purified Soul}, which you have to use on the Sin Devourers to make them disappear (the crystal only lasts **5 seconds**). One shooter (preferably the weakest) handles this the whole time, while the rest of the team attacks the boss.

The druid healing the blocker can stay further from the centre, next to a wall: that way the Sin Devourers mostly go after the other shooters. Shulgrax greatly lowers melee skills: trap him in a corner. He is slightly weak to fire and energy (110%).
After killing Shulgrax, use the {item:Teleportation Rod} on the Godbreaker piece. The exit teleport takes you to the safe room before the entrance.
Godbreaker piece sent; 500,000 XP and Shulgrax's loot (always includes 1 Silver Token)
10. Mazarius's betrayal: the Halls of Ascension
With the seven pieces sent, you discover you have been tricked and head to the place where Ferumbras is preparing his ascension.

After the seventh piece, the last portal takes you back to {npc:Mazarius}'s room, but he is no longer there. From {wiki:Unfinished Letter of Mazarius (Book)|Mazarius's unfinished letter} you find out that you have been betrayed: Mazarius was working for {wiki:Variphor} and stole the Godbreaker pieces.
In his room there is now a new portal leading to the {wiki:Halls of Ascension}, under the Zao Steppe. Only those who have killed the bosses of the seven seals can enter.
Portal to the Halls of Ascension
At the entrance is the {npc:Demonic Messenger}, who gives you tips on how to stop Ferumbras's ascension ritual.
From here on the path is full of enemies. Keep heading **north**, fighting your way through, and go down a hole at the end of the path.
Go **east** and go up the stairs. Keep heading **south** and go down the stairs.
Path (3): west and the south corridor
Go **west** and, in the first room, take the corridor **south**. Continue until you find stairs going down again and go down.
You reach a room shaped like an **8**. Choose one of the paths and keep heading **north** to a portal: it takes you to the final fight's lever room, with spaces for **15 players**.
The fight has four phases and lasts at most 45 minutes. You can only attempt it once every 13 days and 20 hours.

Each player should bring about **2 {item:Convince Creature Rune|Convince Creature Runes}** (required in the 3rd phase). Everyone is advised to use diving equipment ({item:Depth Galea} or {item:Helmet of the Deep}) and {wiki:Mana Drain} protection: they are two very strong sources of damage in this fight.
Without Convince Creature Runes you can't get past the 3rd phase.

Put the team (up to 15) in place and pull the lever. {creature:Ascending Ferumbras} **cannot be killed** at this point: don't waste time on him. There are {creature:Enthralled Demon|Enthralled Demons}, which respawn immediately and have to be blocked, and {creature:Rift Invader|Rift Invaders}, which are needed for the fight. The energy sources on the walls also attack the players.

Eight blue crystal structures surround Ferumbras. To destroy a crystal, kill a Rift Invader **next to** it: the crystal turns pink. The Invaders spawn in the **north** part of the room, so the blockers should pull them from there, especially to the southern crystals. The usual strategy is to leave the south pillar on the west side for last, to prepare the team for the next phase.
Western crystals already destroyed (pink) while a knight blocks the Enthralled Demons to the south
When only one crystal is left, the team gathers in a **corner** near it and destroys it from a distance.

As soon as the last crystal falls, eight {creature:Ferumbras Soul Splinter|Ferumbras Soul Splinters} appear. If the team is well positioned in the corner, only 2 to 4 are in range. As they summon {creature:Demon|Demons} and hit quite hard, pull them slowly and kill them **one by one** with single-target attacks. Each Splinter killed becomes a harmless {creature:Ferumbras Essence}.
The last two Soul Splinters dying

Ferumbras becomes {creature:Destabilized Ferumbras}, who still cannot be killed. Lead each {creature:Ferumbras Essence} onto the vortices left by the Rift Invaders, so that they disappear. When the Essences are gone, {creature:Rift Fragment|Rift Fragments} spawn in the **north**: **convince them** with the Convince Creature Runes, because they are the ones that deal most of the damage to Destabilized Ferumbras. The druids stay near them and use {spell:Mass Healing} to heal them (it also hurts the boss).
The Rift Fragments deal a lot of damage to Destabilized Ferumbras
In this phase the creatures deal **drown damage**: use the {item:Depth Galea} or the {item:Helmet of the Deep}.

Once Destabilized Ferumbras is defeated, he becomes {creature:Ferumbras Mortal Shell}, the last phase: just attack him. He is highly resistant to all elements (including death); physical damage works best. The wiki suggests pulling him to the **south-west** corner of the room.
2,000,000 XP; loot with 1–5 Silver Tokens and a chance of Ferumbras' Hat and Mysterious Scroll

After the victory, use the portal on the **south** side of the room to go to the reward room. Say {key:hi} to the {npc:Heavenly Messenger} to receive the {wiki:Rift Warrior Outfits|Rift Warrior Outfits} and the achievement **Hat Hunter**.
Rift Warrior Outfit and the Hat Hunter achievement

The wiki does not describe the way out of the reward room or the return from the Halls of Ascension to Darashia. If there is no exit teleport there, go back along the Halls of Ascension path to the entrance, next to the {npc:Demonic Messenger}, where you arrived from Mazarius's room in Darashia. Alternatively, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your home town's temple (it does not work in No-Logout zones or with Logout Block / Protection Zone Block).

Any loot you didn't pick up stays in the {wiki:Reward Chest} at the {wiki:Adventurers' Guild}: use an {item:Adventurer's Stone} in the temple of any city to go there and leave through the guild's exit portal, which takes you back to the temple you came from.
The seven seal bosses can be repeated **every 44 hours** (1 day and 20 hours) and Ferumbras **every 13 days and 20 hours**.
All the seal bosses always drop 1 {item:Silver Token}. With 100 Silver Tokens you can buy each Rift Warrior addon from {npc:Cledwyn} (see {wiki:Rift Warrior Outfits Quest}).
The {item:Ferumbras' Hat} is one of the most expensive items in the game and is used for an addon of the Mage (male) / Summoner (female) outfit.
The {item:Mysterious Scroll} is used to obtain the Rift Runner mount, but only those who have completed this quest can use it.
The story of {wiki:The Godbreaker} continues in other quests, such as {wiki:The Secret Library Quest}, where you try to stop Variphor's servants from discovering how to use the weapon.
